about_the_game:
Starfall is a fast, chaotic top-down space shooter where survival is never guaranteed. You’ll dodge endless waves of bullets, take on massive multi-phase bosses, and constantly make split-second choices about how to spend your ship’s limited energy.

Every run feels different. One attempt, you’re a fragile glass cannon firing off devastating lasers. The next, you’re a tanky brawler shrugging off hits while unleashing shockwaves. The talents and gear you pick completely change how your ship handles, making every fight unpredictable.

✦ What You’ll Get

  • Intense bullet hell battles – dodge, weave, and survive against screen-filling chaos.

  • Epic boss fights – each one has its own patterns, shields, teleports, and nasty surprises.

  • Upgrade as you play – collect talents that can turn your ship into something totally new each run.

  • Energy matters – your ship runs on limited power; spend it wisely or get punished fast.

  • Replay again and again – every attempt is different, every build feels unique.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X (or equivalent with Vulkan 1.2 support)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (or better)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: Shoot through dense asteroid fields. Battle enemy fighters, elite squads, and screen-filling bosses. Choose powerful talents to shape your ship — from a beefy tank to a fragile glass cannon. With 10 difficulties, 32+ talents, and no safety nets. You have 1 chance. How far can you get?
